name: Surface
purpose: Apply semantic background layers, boundaries, elevation, radius, and inset without implying a specific content object.
useWhen: A region needs a semantic visual plane but Card, Dialog, or another purposeful component would add the wrong anatomy.

avoidWhen.condition: The region represents one bounded subject with card anatomy.

composition: Choose Surface level and boundary by hierarchy, then compose public layout and content components inside.

rules.statement: Choose surface level by information hierarchy, not decoration alone.
Load styles.css or core.css plus surface.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using arbitrary background colors to recreate a surface.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Surface and theme its semantic tokens.

validation: Check foreground contrast against the selected surface in every appearance.
Confirm nested surfaces communicate hierarchy without excessive borders or elevation.
